headline_seed: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says - BBC
draft_text:
The Pentagon will livestream the firing squad execution of Nidal Malik Hasan, scheduled Dec. 3 at Fort Hood. Hegseth confirmed via Real America's Voice. AP and CBS News report it would be the first U.S. military execution since 1961.

And that's the mews.
